Title: http_ttl_triple (
Description:
Outputs next triple to ses in TTL serialization. This function does not terminate the printed
    	triple in hope that the next triple will has same "s" or pair of "s" and "p". So "intermediate"
    	semicolon or comma can be used instead of "trailing" dot.
Examples: create procedure dump_rdftriples_to_ttl(inout triples any, inout ses any)
